title: Minimum Number of Operations to Move All Balls to Each Box
goal: Compute moves needed to gather all balls into each box independently.
strategy: A left-to-right scan accumulates movement cost from balls on the left; a mirrored scan adds costs from the right. Each step increases cost by the number of balls passed.
